title: Website chat widget asks for name, phone or email (configurable) so a chat can become a lead, with consent recorded
goal: An agency chooses when the website chat asks for contact details and which fields are required; the visitor's details are stored on the conversation with consent, and the chat becomes a lead by one click or automatically.
why: Gap 8: the widget sends only the message, so 'Create lead' fails with "Add the visitor's name, phone or email before creating a lead" (routes/chatbot.ts ~429). Design: TOUR-OPERATOR-DESIGN.md sections 4.8 and 13.1.

steps: 0061: chatbot_config ADD contact_capture TEXT; schema; bundle. Defaults of design 4.8 (mode off = today's behaviour).
GET /public/chatbot/:widgetKey/config returns the capture config (mode, fields, consent text, labels) in addition to today's fields.

POST /public/chatbot/:widgetKey/contact {visitorId, conversationId, name?, email?, phone?, consent: true, marketingOptIn?}: same widget key resolution, origin allow-list and ai_chatbot check as /messages; 10 per 10 minutes per IP; email format; phone normalised with the agency default country; required fields per config and requireOneOf; stores on the conversation; consent row source chatbot (marketing only when opted in); event chatbot.contact_captured.

services/domain/chatbot-leads.ts: the lead-from-conversation logic moved out of routes/chatbot.ts (findOrCreateContact, createLead, link conversation); the staff route calls it (behaviour unchanged); autoCreateLead calls it after capture.

widgetScript renders a small form at the configured moment (before_chat, after_first_reply, before_handoff) with the agency's labels and consent text; text-only DOM (no innerHTML of agency strings), keyboard accessible, works on mobile widths.
Settings > Chatbot: a 'Ask for contact details' section (mode, each field required/optional/hidden, at least one of email or phone, consent text, marketing opt-in, auto-create lead).
Chatbot conversations: the visitor's name, email and phone in the side panel; Create lead enabled when details exist.

tests: backend/test/chatbot-contact-capture.test.ts: config defaults; required field missing 400; phone normalised for an NL agency; consent recorded (and marketing only when ticked); autoCreateLead creates one contact and lead and links the conversation, a second capture does not duplicate; origin not allowed 403; rate limit; mode off keeps today's behaviour.
Existing chatbot-create-lead and public-chatbot tests stay green.
e2e/chatbot.spec.ts: with mode before_chat the widget asks for name and phone, the conversation shows them and Create lead works; auto-create makes the lead without a click.
acceptance: A website chat can become a lead without staff asking for details.
Agencies that leave the setting off see no change.
gate: cd backend && npx vitest run   # 0 failed files; passed >= the count at the last merge
cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
cd desktop && npx vitest run   # 0 failing files; passed >= the count at the last merge
cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3120 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8807/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/chatbot.spec.ts e2e/marketing-opt-out.spec.ts
productRules: Generic product: no prospect or customer names anywhere.
Feature switch: ai_chatbot as today; the capture is an agency setting, default off.
Public route: tenant from the widget key first; origin allow-list; rate limits; no tenant data in answers.
Backend: tenant migration 0061 only; regenerate the bundle; consent records written.
Desktop: CONTRACT.md; t() with en and nl keys in chatbot.json; RTL-safe classes.
Never weaken, skip or delete an existing test.
notes: Before editing read: this file, TOUR-OPERATOR-DESIGN.md sections 4.8 and 13.1, routes/public-chatbot.ts, routes/chatbot.ts (handleChatbotMessage, create-lead), backend/test/public-chatbot.test.ts.
The widget must never call AI for the contact form; only /messages may.
